name: Sulphurhound Cybercanid

bonuses.name: Gyro-stabilised Saddle
bonuses.text: Whenever the Cybercanid is being ridden by its bonded Serberys rider, the bonded Serberys rider may reroll any Wrath Die that rolls a Complication.

bonuses.name: Noospheric Link
bonuses.text: Whenever the Cybercanid is being ridden by its bonded Serberys rider, the bonded Serberys rider may use its movement to command the Cybercanid to move and take an Action.

determination: Enhanced Bionics: Spend 1 Ruin (or Wrath, if the cyber-beast is your mount) to roll 6d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: No Default skill printed (skills.default null). Gyro-stabilised Saddle lacks the Raider's 'must take the second result' clause, as printed.
